title: Core value lists
description: Closed value lists of /contracts v1. Each list is a distinct named type (OD-P-10): a value of one list is never valid for another. contracts/state-registry.md is the vendored copy of the single normative home, docs/engineering/state-registry.md; tools/contracts/validate.py fails when this file and the copy differ in any way (DEC-2026-10-16 money-and-value-lists §2.4).

RetrySafety.description: SoT §43.8. NONE is never retried automatically (INV-24).

ConcurrencyControl.description: SoT §43.8. With CONDITIONAL_WRITE every write passes the grant's version tokens (INV-27).

ConsequenceLevel.description: SoT §43.8, for financial, customer, regulatory, access and operational.

EvaluationTime.description: SoT §15.3. AT_DECISION is the default. The policy author sets it; Trust never infers it.

IntentStatus.description: Intent Object status. EXTRACTED then VALIDATED or REJECTED_AT_GATE, set once at the gate. SUPERSEDED was removed: supersession is derived from the 'supersedes' link (money-and-value-lists §2.1). Only VALIDATED crosses into Trust.

DecisionOutcome.description: Decision Record outcome: exactly one per decision (SoT §13.1). A Decision Grant is issued only on ALLOW.

AuthorityResult.description: Result of one authority layer (technical, policy, business). OVERRIDDEN was removed (money-and-value-lists §2.2): nobody can override the business layer.

CoreReasonCode.description: The 17 core (tier 1) reason codes, a closed list. The last three are [REC] until the founders confirm them. Pack codes (<vertical>.reason.<name>) are the second tier and live in the pack's catalogue.

LimitSetBy.description: Which limit set the effective freshness limit (SoT §43.2).

ConfirmationResponse.description: An approver's response. ACCEPT leads to a fresh Trust evaluation, never straight to a grant.

ConfirmationTerminalState.description: Terminal state of a confirmation request that was not answered in time.

FactStatus.description: Status of an evidence item (SoT §43.5). A missing record is UNAVAILABLE or UNKNOWN, never a negative fact (INV-19).

ExecutionState.description: Execution Receipt state. Execution never writes SUCCEEDED (that word belongs to Outcome). Not the synthetic transaction state EXECUTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (OD-P-10).

Verdict.description: Outcome Verdict (SoT §43.4). Anything except ACHIEVED creates a RecoveryRequest to Trust.

FindingSeverity.description: Benchmark finding severity (SoT §38.3). Not a data sensitivity class (OD-P-10).

DataSensitivity.description: Data sensitivity class, for example S3_financial_pii. The SoT gives examples only, so the shape is constrained, not the list. Distinct from FindingSeverity (OD-P-10).

Mode.description: Deployment mode (SoT §16). The POC builds Mode 1 only; a MODE_2 proposal is rejected at runtime with MODE_NOT_ENABLED (REQ-TRU-011).
